messages:
maria: Heads up — during a dry-run key rotation in staging we saw KMS audit events that reference workspace_id=ws-8274 which belongs to a different tenant. Not sure if it's a logging alias bug or a real decrypt.

dane: Can you paste the raw audit line?

maria: Here it is (sanitized):
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-19T22:13:07Z","event":"kms:Decrypt","key_alias":"alias/redwood/ws-1234","caller":"service-account:renderer","workspace_id":"ws-8274","request_id":"req-9a7"}
```

vikram: @security-sre can you triage? if that's real we have cross-tenant exposure during rotation.

ops-bot: rotation-job/rotate-2026-03-19 finished: key=alias/redwood/ws-1234 status=success run_by=rotation-runner-7

elaine: Could be stale alias-to-workspace mapping in kms-proxy cache. We changed alias resolution to use the new workspace->key table last week; maybe the background reconciler didn't run.

dane: Search audit index for same request_id across tenants: `curl -s \"https://logs.internal/audit/_search?q=request_id:req-9a7\" | jq .hits.hits[]._source`

maria: I ran that — same request_id shows only in staging cluster, but the workspace_id fields are mixed: ws-1234 and ws-8274 both present in separate events within 30s.

security-sre: If both ws IDs appear with same request_id that's suspicious. Could be a logging transform that substitutes workspace based on previous mapping. Steps: 1) freeze rotations 2) revoke temporary grants 3) collect stack traces from kms-proxy 4) run grep over rotation runner

vikram: Paging infra to block any further decrypts from rotation-runner in prod: `iptables -A OUTPUT -d kms.internal -j DROP` — kidding, but let's put rotation jobs in safe mode.

elaine: I'll flush kms-proxy cache on staging now and re-run rotation in read-only mode. Also pushing small change to add request_id propagation so we can trace path.

maria: Flushed cache. Re-ran on staging in dry-run — got same mixed workspace_id in logs. Stack traces from proxy attached: (short snippet)
```text
at proxy.ResolveAlias(alias)
at proxy.HandleDecrypt(req)
```

dane: Look at alias table snapshot: `/var/data/alias_map/2026-03-19.snap` shows alias -> workspace mapping toggled during reconciler run. Maybe reconciler applied delta mid-rotation.

security-sre: Mitigation: add strict verification at kms-proxy that `key_alias` tag workspace == request.workspace_id OR reject. Also add audit tag `rotation_run_id`. For immediate: add env var `KMS_PROXY_STRICT=true` on staging.

maria: Filed ISSUE-SEC-421 with repro and logs. I'm going to revoke any ephemeral grants created by rotation-runner for last 2 hours.

vikram: Can we add an alert for 'audit.events where caller=rotation-runner AND multiple workspace_ids per request_id'? Pls add to alerting.

elaine: On it, alert rule pushed to staging: `multi_workspace_decrypts` -> notify #incidents and pagerduty.

maria: Thanks — will keep monitoring. If we see anything in prod we escalate to incident. :eyes: 

audit-bot: audit-indexer: found 3 related events in staging between 2026-03-19T22:12:50Z and 2026-03-19T22:13:20Z, linked to request_id:req-9a7"
